attempted_battles.pre_battle_setup_policy: advance native seeded game with first currently legal action until the first battle

budget_semantics: total shared-tree simulations per actual public decision; not multiplied by particle count; particle index cycles simulation_index modulo 32
cohort_generation: IRONCLAD, ascension 0, game seeds 1..8; first native battle reached by advancing each seeded run with its first currently legal action; no encounter or sampler-support filtering
controller: adaptive shared-public-tree UCT; one tree per actual decision, shared by 32 sampled particles; public state/action/result history keys; action selected from shared root visits/value only
interpretation: Only 2 of 24 attempts per budget completed with sampler support at every public decision (8.3%). The other 22 attempts per budget stopped at a fail-closed monster or player status-timing boundary. The single paired fully supported completion showed no win change and is insufficient for an outcome-benefit claim. Decision latency scaled about fourfold from 96 to 384 simulations, as expected for fixed per-decision work. Next work should improve public-state/sampler coverage before increasing search budgets or interpreting battle outcomes.
leaf_evaluation: terminal battle win/loss is +1/-1; at 24 public-action decisions clamp(player_hp/max_hp - 0.5 * sum(monster_hp/max_hp), -1, 1) using public state
limitations: small deterministic first-battle cohort; not a broad strength or A20 claim
first-legal-action setup before the first battle is fixed and may not represent a player route policy
unsupported sampler decisions stop the controller without fallback
search rollouts truncate at 24 public-action decisions with a public HP-fraction heuristic
wall times are local single-process measurements and exclude compilation

paired_budget_comparison.interpretation: descriptive paired signal only; small fixed cohort is not a strength estimate

sampler_interpretation: reproducible proposal distribution, not an exact posterior
work_counter_definition: native public-action steps count step_public_action calls in sampled search trajectories plus real controller actions; simulator-internal queue steps are not separately instrumented
